ideas.title: DOJ Investigation into Minnesota Leaders
ideas.description: This story would investigate the DOJ's investigation into Minnesota leaders for obstruction of immigration enforcement.
ideas.angle: The story would explore the details of the investigation and its potential impact on Minnesota politics.
questions: What are the specific allegations against Governor Walz and Mayor Frey?
How will the investigation impact Minnesota's politics?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it has the potential to reveal corruption and abuse of power in Minnesota's government.
